placements.why: Both expressions describe test infrastructure — the e2e suite and a probe memory — whose purpose is to assert and verify system behavior (reviewer enrollment on memory creation). This is proof-category content: artifacts that exist to verify what the system does, and no existing strata or narrative leaf holds it.
placements.title: from claims to executable assertions about system behavior
placements.frame: What does the test infrastructure assert about the system it verifies, and how do proof artifacts encode the behaviors they check?

placements.title: the test artifact becomes a mere carrier for the assertion it makes about the system
placements.frame: When a test artifact declares its own purpose as merely carrying an assertion about the system under test, what does that self-description reveal about the relationship between proof infrastructure and the behavior it verifies?
placements.why: Both expressions perform the same instrumental self-description: src-1 settles the decision that the e2e suite asserts reviewer enrollment on memory creation, and src-2 frames the probe memory's entire existence as a vehicle for that assertion. The theme is a test artifact naming its own function as a carrier of an assertion about the system under test — a subject future envelopes about test self-awareness and assertion-as-purpose would feed.
